title: Story for the bank
summary:
One question, one real story. Your answer goes only to the private story bank (customers repo), never this repo. I won't write it for you. (The steering committee and mentor questions stay open if you'd rather answer one of those.)

**Tonight's question - a customer surprise:** Think of a time a customer used something you delivered in a way nobody planned for - or told you the thing that mattered wasn't the thing you built. What happened, and what did you change afterward?
